component.name: Pusher
component.summary: Clone and push a GitLab repository

description.p: Pusher clones a GitLab repository into the Gitlab folder of your home directory, and pushes your local changes back with a single button.
Push fiable : commits non envoyés regroupés, annulés après un échec, nouvel essai automatique (port 443), barre de progression, statut et taille de chaque fichier, alerte sur les gros fichiers.
Errors are shown in a dialog with the full, copyable message instead of a one-line toast.
SSH keep-alive so long pushes survive flaky networks.
Detects an unfinished rebase or merge and warns instead of syncing; fixes a markup error in Git messages.
